caveats.statement: posts 表的创建时间列名拼写为 CreaionDate 而非 CreationDate,直接写 CreationDate 会报错
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE CreaionDate IS NOT NULL

caveats.statement: posts.Tags 是形如 '<tag1><tag2>' 的字符串,需用 LIKE '%<tag>%' 匹配,不能直接等值比较
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE Tags LIKE '%<humor>%'

caveats.statement: 部分帖子 OwnerUserId 为空(社区 wiki 或已删除用户),按用户聚合时会丢失这些帖子
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId IS NULL

caveats.statement: users.Age 存在 NULL 值,计算平均年龄时会被忽略或导致偏差
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE Age IS NULL

caveats.statement: posts.FavoriteCount 存在 NULL 值,求最大值或平均时需注意
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE FavoriteCount IS NULL

caveats.statement: votes.BountyAmount 多数为 NULL,仅悬赏类投票有值
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE BountyAmount IS NULL

caveats.statement: tags.ExcerptPostId 与 WikiPostId 可能为 NULL,关联帖子时需过滤
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE ExcerptPostId IS NULL OR WikiPostId IS NULL

caveats.statement: comments.UserId 可能为 NULL,按评论者聚合时会丢失记录
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE UserId IS NULL

caveats.statement: posts.ClosedDate 仅对已关闭帖子有值,统计关闭率时需注意 NULL
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE ClosedDate IS NULL

caveats.statement: 同一业务概念在名称列中可能有多种写法(如徽章、标签),需用 IN 覆盖全部代码
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Name FROM badges WHERE Name IN ('Student','Teacher')
